description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the $S_r$ ratio and certain performance metrics. The x-axis represents the $S_r$ ratio, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1, and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis is not explicitly labeled but appears to represent two different metrics: GPU memory usage and perplexity. The left y-axis, corresponding to GPU memory usage, has a linear scale ranging from approximately 0 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 20. The right y-axis, corresponding to perplexity, also has a linear scale, ranging from approximately 4 to 8, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. There are two lines in the plot: one representing GPU memory usage, shown in a certain color with a solid line style, and the other representing perplexity, shown in another color with a solid line style. The GPU memory usage line starts at around 100 at an $S_r$ ratio of 0, decreases to a minimum of around 60 at an $S_r$ ratio of 0.4-0.6, and then increases to around 80 at an $S_r$ ratio of 1. The perplexity line starts at around 7.5 at an $S_r$ ratio of 0, decreases to a minimum of around 5.5 at an $S_r$ ratio of 0.4-0.6, and then increases slightly to around 6 at an $S_r$ ratio of 1.
